meta.title: Phone2Laptop — Transfer files between your phone and computer
meta.description: Transfer photos, PDFs, videos, links and notes between your phone and computer. No app, account or cable.

hero.title: Move files from your phone to your computer in seconds.
hero.subtitle: Scan a QR code and immediately transfer photos, PDFs, videos, links or notes. No app, account or cable.
hero.trust: No account · No installation · Compatible with iPhone, Android, Windows and Mac

how.title: One scan is enough.
how.intro: Phone2Laptop temporarily connects your phone and computer through their browsers. No complex setup required.

steps.title: Display the QR code
steps.text: Open Phone2Laptop on your computer. A unique QR code is generated for your session.

steps.title: Scan it with your phone
steps.text: Scan the QR code with your phone camera. Both devices access the same session.

steps.title: Send your content
steps.text: Transfer a file, photo, document, link or note in either direction.

items.title: Photos and videos
items.text: Quickly retrieve a photo taken on your phone on your computer.

items.title: PDFs and documents
items.text: Send a document to your phone to view, sign or share it.

items.title: Notes and links
items.text: Copy an address, link or text between devices without messaging yourself.

items.title: Every ecosystem
items.text: Transfer between Android and Mac, iPhone and Windows, or any combination with a modern browser.

comparison.title: More direct than email, cloud storage or a cable.
comparison.intro: You should not need to email yourself, find a cable or upload to the cloud to move a document between two devices in front of you.

security.title: Your transfers stay private.
security.intro: Phone2Laptop is designed to limit the data it handles and how long transferred content is retained.

items.title: No user profile
items.text: No account is required. Phone2Laptop does not create a personal profile associated with your transfers.

items.title: Encrypted content
items.text: Files and notes are encrypted in your browser with AES-GCM before upload. The key travels in the session link fragment and is not sent to our server.

items.title: Temporary retention
items.text: Content remains encrypted on the server. After the first file upload, the session expires 30 minutes later. You can also delete it immediately.

items.title: Transparent scope
items.text: A note alone does not currently start the 30-minute timer. Do not use the service as storage and delete the session after use.
A modern browser is all both devices need
